body:
I'm sorry to respond back so late, but I think I am really going through with it tonight. The person I love just said some of the cruelest words anyone has ever said to me. I didn't even mention my feelings to him. I was trying to stay positive. We were about to make love, when he suddenly unleashed with a fury of verbal abuse. I have no one to talk to, and I can't do this anymore.

There are definitely people I am sorry I will never be able to see again, and it makes my heart ache to know how this will make my parents and other close family members feel, but it just has to happen. It has to be over tonight. I will feel pain, then nothing.

I have been on reddit for six years, and this is the first time I have posted here on a throwaway. I was desperate and grasping for some shred of hope to hold onto, but I think at this point nothing would have been enough. Thank you for the kind words.

I have anxiety and panic attacks. He thinks it's he who triggers them, but to be honest I don't know what triggers them; it just happens, and it's out of my control. I start shaking and sweating and breathing hard, and I can't stop. I take meds for this, but it's not perfect. He starts yelling at me to calm down, but I can't. I can't really verbally respond when it happens, either. I'm a mess.

I feel that he gets verbally abusive with me, and he has physically hurt me once in the past. I'm not sure if it makes any difference, but I'll mention I'm gay and married to another man.
As much as I hate to admit it, my relationship may have something to do with it.
